name: Ensnaring Lash (Combat, Technique)
body:
By wrapping a limb or weapon around a foe’s weapon or body, you restrict their movement.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Improved Unarmed Strike or weapon proficiency in a weapon from the flails weapon group, Weapon Finesse

Benefit(s): In place of an attack, you may attempt a CMB check to wrap one of your limbs or a weapon from the flail weapon group (such as a meteor hammer, nunchaku, spiked chain, or whip) around the target’s body or wielded weapon. You cannot make attacks with a manufactured weapon used in this way, and if you use a limb you take a -2 penalty on attack rolls with natural attacks until the target is released. The target moves at half speed and must attempt the pull maneuver against you to move at normal speed as part of their movement (failure meaning they move at half speed), or they can try to untangle themselves using a CMB check as a standard action. If they would leave your reach, you may either move with them, subtracting every 5 feet moved from your movement speed on your next turn, or you must release their body or weapon. If you move your full speed in this way, you are staggered next turn. If you move twice your speed, you are knocked prone and the target is released. If your wrap the target’s body, they take a -2 penalty on attack rolls with natural attacks until they are released. If you wrap a weapon, they take a -2 penalty on attack rolls with that weapon until released. If you wrap a manufactured weapon with a limb, the target may attack you at no penalty with that weapon, but takes the penalty against all other targets. You may release a target from this maneuver as a free action. You may only perform this maneuver against a creature up to 1 size category larger than you.
